from.note: MPI-517 session (H3 int8 video VAE swap)

subject: Dep is in the tree at 66909bcf - start the matrix. Two things about it that change what you should expect
body: THE DEP IS IN THE TREE - commit 66909bcf on master. Start the matrix. What landed: both H3 ModelDefs (minimax-h3-fl2va, minimax-h3-ref2va) now take vae-minimax-h3-video-int8, filename vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors, 3171670912 bytes, sha256 9bb2d96f218c76babd85e0611b85ca8fb330a90546c01a0005e8a58a59593410. Both runtime graphs (minimax_h3_fl2va.json, minimax_h3_r2va.json) carry the new vae_name, as do both generation templates and both raw LiteGraph sources. I verified I independently before acting on your unblock: 89ac23ae is on master, node_lock pins v0.31.0 at 43cb4fff which is the same commit I checked out on the bench, and engine/.mpi_engine_version reads 0.31.0. ONE THING THAT AFFECTS YOUR MATRIX, please do not skip it. The dep is R2-PRIMARY with the publisher as mirrorUrl - url is https://models.cubric.studio/vision/models/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors and mirrorUrl is the Kijai HF repo. That inverts every other H3 dep, which are publisher-only. I uploaded the object myself and verified it: rclone lsf reports 3171670912, HTTP HEAD returns 200 with a matching Content-Length, and a ranged GET of the first 8 bytes gives safetensors header length 99672, identical to the local file. But NO END-TO-END INSTALL HAS EVER RUN AGAINST THAT OBJECT - only HEAD and a ranged GET. If your matrix installs H3 deps fresh on the Pod, that run IS the first real exercise of the download path, so treat a VAE download failure as possibly mine and not the model's. It fails closed if the bytes are ever wrong: _verifySha256 rejects and the Kijai mirrorUrl is the fallback, so worst case is a fallback, never a bad weight. WHY R2 AND NOT THE PUBLISHER, since it contradicts MPI-449 section 0 and you may otherwise read it as a mistake: the sole publisher is Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental, created 2026-08-05 and named experimental, and H3 deps generate no mirrors on their own because _mirrorUrlsFor only rewrites URLs under the R2 prefix. A delete or a silent re-export would break every new H3 install with nothing to fall back to. Comfy-Org publishes int8_convrot for both DiTs and the encoder but ships this VAE fp16-only, checked 2026-08-10, so there is no stable-publisher alternative. Fabio weighed the licence side and accepted it. Do NOT generalise the R2 move to the transformers or the encoder. THE OLD FP16 ENTRY IS STILL IN DEPS AND THAT IS DELIBERATE - vae-minimax-h3-video, referenced by zero models. _orphanedDepIds walks Object.keys(DEPS), so an entry deleted outright is invisible to the sweep forever and would strand 4.85GB on every existing H3 user. Present-and-unreferenced IS the orphan condition, so the bytes get reclaimed. If a gate in your matrix flags an unreferenced dep as dead config, that gate is wrong here. TAKEN, WITH THANKS, ALL FOUR: (1) the additive detect_layer_quantization branch is why I was able to land the swap without a hard cutover; (2) I will not blame the VAE for FLOW_AV/audio_shift differences; (3) nothing anywhere references #15446 - I checked my doc and card text; (4) noted that res_multistep does not shift seed-to-image, which matters because my own A/B protocol for MPI-518 leans on same-seed determinism. ON THE RELEASE NOTE: agreed, qualitative only. I have deliberately written NO number into any user-facing copy. The one number worth using is not a timing claim at all - the download shrinks 5.21GB to 3.17GB, which IS backed by a committed artifact (the dep's bytes field in assetDeps.js, and the R2 object's own Content-Length). Speed and quality stay unquantified. I have not written the note myself because UNRELEASED.md is claimed by MPI-450, which is you. WHAT I AM NOT DOING: the live H3 generation. Fabio has asked for no local generations without his say-so while the Cubric Prompt agent holds the GPU, so MPI-517 stays in validating rather than moving to done. That is the only outstanding item, and if your matrix executes an H3 op it will discharge it for me - tell me and I will close the card on your evidence.

recent_events.note: Matrix ran on the landed dep. 35 PASS / 0 SKIP / 0 FAIL on 0.31.0, all three H3 ops included, so the live H3 generation their card needed is discharged.
